blocks.tamil_translation: without putting me to trial, take me to You! O Allah! I ask You for Your love, and the love of the one who loves You, and the love of the deed that brings Your love near,” I made this du'a. This du'a is true; recite it many times in order to learn it,” Hazrat Mu'adh ibn Jabal (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: أَحَدُكُمْ فِي صَلَاةٍ مَادَامَتِ الصَّلَاةُ تَحْبِسُهُ، وَالْمَلَائِكَةُ تَقُولُ: اَللّهُمَّ اغْفِرْ لَهُ وَارْحَمْهُ، مَالَمْ يَقُمْ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ أَوْ يُحْدِثْ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abu Hurairah (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “As long as one of you remains waiting for Salah, he keeps receiving the reward of Salah, and the angels keep making du'a for him, “O Allah! Forgive him, and have mercy on him!” For as long as he sits with Wudu in the place where he prayed (even after the Salah), the angels keep making this same du'a for him.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ ﵁ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: مُنْتَظِرُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الصَّلَاةِ، كَفَارِسِ نِ اشْتَدَّ بِهِ فَرَسُهُ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ عَلَي كَشْحِهِ وَهُوَ فِي الرِّبَاطِ اْلاَكْبَرِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد والطبراني في الاوسط، واسناد احمد صالح، الترغيب:٢٨٤/١
blocks.tamil_translation: “The one who, after one Salah, waits for the next Salah is like a horseman. His horse carries him and goes very swiftly in the path of Allah. The one waiting for Salah is with a very great army (in the ranks against the nafs and Shaytan),” said the Prophet ﷺ
